ADPTag.description: Tags provided by an ADP describing the CVE Record.
ADPTag.title: ADPTag

AdpContainer.description: An object containing vulnerability information provided by an Authorized Data Publisher (ADP). Multiple ADPs can provide containers for a single CVE ID.

adp_tags.description: Tags provided by an ADP describing the CVE Record.

affected.description: List of affected products and services.

cna_source.description: Source information (who discovered it, who researched it, etc.) and optionally a chain of CNA information.

configurations_text.description: Configurations required for exploiting this vulnerability.

cpe_applicability.description: Affected products defined using the CPE Applicability Language. When defined, this block should align with the data in the affected block.

credits.description: Statements acknowledging specific people, organizations, or tools for work related to research, discovery, remediation, or coordination of this CVE.

cve_references.description: Reference data in the form of URLs describing the vulnerability, such as advisories, patches, and exploit details. Required by CNA rules.

date_public.description: If known, the date/time the vulnerability was disclosed publicly.

descriptions.description: A list of multi-lingual descriptions of the vulnerability. Must contain at least one English language entry. E.g., [PROBLEMTYPE] in [COMPONENT] in [VENDOR] [PRODUCT] [VERSION] on [PLATFORMS] allows [ATTACKER] to [IMPACT] via [VECTOR].

exploits.description: Information about known exploits of this vulnerability.

impacts.description: Collection of impacts of this vulnerability, optionally linked to CAPEC IDs.

metrics.description: Collection of impact scores with attribution (CVSSv2, CVSSv3.0, CVSSv3.1, CVSSv4.0, or custom format).

problem_types.description: Problem type information such as CWE identifiers. Must contain at least one entry. Entries can be text, OWASP, or CWE identifiers.

provider_metadata.description: Details related to the information container provider (CNA or ADP).

solutions.description: Information about solutions or remediations available for this vulnerability.

taxonomy_mappings.description: List of taxonomy items (e.g., ATT&CK, CWE) related to the vulnerability.

timeline.description: Timeline information for significant events about the vulnerability or changes to the CVE Record.

title.description: Short human-readable title or name for this entity.

workarounds.description: Workarounds and mitigations for this vulnerability.

AdpContainer.title: AdpContainer

AffectedProduct.description: Information about the set of products and services affected by a vulnerability. At least one of (vendor + product) or (collectionURL + packageName) is required, and at least one of versions or defaultStatus is required.

collection_url.description: URL identifying a package collection (determines the meaning of packageName).

cpes.description: Affected products defined by CPE (Common Platform Enumeration) names in either 2.2 or 2.3 format.

default_status.description: The default status for versions not otherwise listed in the versions list. Defaults to 'unknown' if not specified. Versions or defaultStatus may be omitted, but not both.

modules.description: A list of the affected components, features, modules, sub-components, sub-products, APIs, commands, utilities, programs, or functionalities.

name.description: Name of the entity (product, weakness, reference, etc.).

package_name.description: Name or identifier of the affected software package as used in the package collection.

package_url.description: A Package URL (PURL), a unified URL specification for identifying packages hosted by known package hosts. The Package URL MUST NOT include a version.

program_files.description: A list of the affected source code files.

program_routines.description: A list of the affected source code functions, methods, subroutines, or procedures.

repo.description: The URL of the source code repository, for informational purposes and/or to resolve git hash version ranges.

vendor.description: Name of the vendor or organization responsible for the product.

version.description: Version string of the affected product.

versions.description: Set of product versions or version ranges related to the vulnerability. Versions or defaultStatus may be omitted, but not both.

AffectedProduct.title: AffectedProduct

Any.description: A linkml placeholder class accepting any JSON-compatible value (string, number, boolean, object, or array). Use for slots that hold arbitrary or schema-less data.
Any.title: Any

CNATag.description: Tags provided by a CNA describing the CVE Record.
CNATag.title: CNATag

CVERecord.description: Official CVE Record corresponding to a CVE ID. Represents either a Published or Rejected record in the CVE™ Program. The dataType field is always CVE_RECORD. Use cveMetadata.state to distinguish Published from Rejected records.

containers.description: A set of containers (CNA and optionally ADP) holding vulnerability information related to the CVE ID.

cve_id.description: The CVE identifier assigned by a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA). Format: CVE-YYYY-NNNNN.

cve_metadata.description: Metadata about the CVE ID. A Published record uses CveMetadataPublished; a Rejected record uses CveMetadataRejected.

data_type.description: Indicates the type of information represented in the JSON instance.

data_version.description: The version of the CVE schema used for validating this record. Supports multiple versions of the format (e.g., '5.2.0').

impact.description: Impact and severity assessment for this vulnerability.

last_modified_date.description: Date and time the vulnerability record was last modified.

published_date.description: Date and time the vulnerability was first published.

references.description: External references such as advisories and articles.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the vulnerability record.

title.description: Short human-readable title or name for this entity.

weaknesses.description: Weakness classifications (e.g. CWE) associated with this vulnerability.

CVERecord.title: CVERecord

CnaPublishedContainer.description: An object containing vulnerability information provided by a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) for a published CVE ID. There can only be one CNA container per CVE record since there can only be one assigning CNA.

affected.description: List of affected products and services.

cna_source.description: Source information (who discovered it, who researched it, etc.) and optionally a chain of CNA information.

cna_tags.description: Tags provided by a CNA describing the CVE Record.

configurations_text.description: Configurations required for exploiting this vulnerability.

cpe_applicability.description: Affected products defined using the CPE Applicability Language. When defined, this block should align with the data in the affected block.

credits.description: Statements acknowledging specific people, organizations, or tools for work related to research, discovery, remediation, or coordination of this CVE.

cve_references.description: Reference data in the form of URLs describing the vulnerability, such as advisories, patches, and exploit details. Required by CNA rules.

date_assigned.description: The date/time this CVE ID was associated with a vulnerability by a CNA.

date_public.description: If known, the date/time the vulnerability was disclosed publicly.

descriptions.description: A list of multi-lingual descriptions of the vulnerability. Must contain at least one English language entry. E.g., [PROBLEMTYPE] in [COMPONENT] in [VENDOR] [PRODUCT] [VERSION] on [PLATFORMS] allows [ATTACKER] to [IMPACT] via [VECTOR].

exploits.description: Information about known exploits of this vulnerability.

impacts.description: Collection of impacts of this vulnerability, optionally linked to CAPEC IDs.

metrics.description: Collection of impact scores with attribution (CVSSv2, CVSSv3.0, CVSSv3.1, CVSSv4.0, or custom format).

problem_types.description: Problem type information such as CWE identifiers. Must contain at least one entry. Entries can be text, OWASP, or CWE identifiers.

provider_metadata.description: Details related to the information container provider (CNA or ADP).

solutions.description: Information about solutions or remediations available for this vulnerability.

taxonomy_mappings.description: List of taxonomy items (e.g., ATT&CK, CWE) related to the vulnerability.

timeline.description: Timeline information for significant events about the vulnerability or changes to the CVE Record.

title.description: Short human-readable title or name for this entity.

workarounds.description: Workarounds and mitigations for this vulnerability.

CnaPublishedContainer.title: CnaPublishedContainer

CnaRejectedContainer.description: An object containing vulnerability information provided by a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) for a rejected CVE ID. There can only be one CNA container per CVE record.

provider_metadata.description: Details related to the information container provider (CNA or ADP).

rejected_reasons.description: Reasons for rejecting this CVE Record.

replaced_by.description: CVE IDs that this CVE ID was rejected in favor of because this CVE ID was incorrectly assigned to the same vulnerabilities.

CnaRejectedContainer.title: CnaRejectedContainer

Configuration.description: Logical grouping of CPE match expressions.

cpe_uri.description: CPE 2.2 URI identifying an affected product configuration.

operator.description: Logical operator (AND/OR) used in configuration node groupings.

Configuration.title: Configuration

Containers.description: A set of structures (called containers) used to store vulnerability information related to a specific CVE ID. At minimum a 'cna' container is required.

adp.description: One or more ADP containers providing additional vulnerability information. Multiple ADPs may contribute containers for the same CVE ID.

cna.description: The CNA container holding vulnerability information for this CVE ID. For published records, this is a CnaPublishedContainer. For rejected records, this is a CnaRejectedContainer.

Containers.title: Containers

CpeApplicabilityElement.description: Affected products defined using an implementation of the CPE Applicability Language. An operator property allows AND or OR logic between CPEs or combinations of CPEs.

cpe_negate.description: If true, negates the applicability of this element.

cpe_operator.description: Logical operator (AND/OR) used between CPE criteria in this node.

CpeApplicabilityElement.title: CpeApplicabilityElement

CpeMatch.description: CPE match string or range within a CPE applicability node.

cpe_criteria.description: CPE 2.3 formatted name match string or match criteria.

cpe_vulnerable.description: Whether this CPE match describes a vulnerable configuration.

match_criteria_id.description: UUID identifying the CPE match criteria set.

version_end_excluding.description: The end of a version range, exclusive (versions strictly less than this).

version_end_including.description: The end of a version range, inclusive (versions less than or equal to this).

version_start_excluding.description: The start of a version range, exclusive (versions strictly greater than this).

version_start_including.description: The start of a version range, inclusive (versions greater than or equal to this).

CpeMatch.title: CpeMatch

CpeNode.description: Defines a CPE configuration node in an applicability statement.

cpe_match_criteria.description: Array of CPE match criteria within this node.

cpe_negate.description: If true, negates the applicability of this element.

cpe_operator.description: Logical operator (AND/OR) used between CPE criteria in this node.

CpeNode.title: CpeNode

CpeOperator.description: Logical operator used in CPE applicability nodes.
CpeOperator.title: CpeOperator

CreditEntry.description: A credit acknowledging a specific person, organization, or tool for work related to the research, discovery, remediation, or coordination of the vulnerability.

credit_type.description: Type or role of the entity being credited.

credit_user.description: UUID of the user being credited, if present in the CVE User Registry. This UUID can be used to lookup the user record in the user registry service.

credit_value.description: The name or description of the credited party (up to 4096 characters).

lang.description: BCP 47 language code indicating the language of accompanying text.

CreditEntry.title: CreditEntry

CreditType.description: Type or role of the entity being credited.
CreditType.title: CreditType

CveMetadataPublished.description: Metadata for a CVE Record in the PUBLISHED state.

assigner_org_id.description: The UUID for the organization to which the CVE ID was originally assigned. This UUID can be used to lookup the organization record in the user registry service.

assigner_short_name.description: The short name for the organization to which the CVE ID was originally assigned.

date_published.description: The date/time the CVE Record was first published in the CVE List.

date_reserved.description: The date/time this CVE ID was reserved in the CVE automation workgroup services system. This date does not necessarily indicate when the vulnerability was discovered, shared with the vendor, or publicly disclosed.

date_updated.description: The date/time the record was last updated.

published_state.description: State of the CVE Record. For published records, this is always PUBLISHED.

record_cve_id.description: The CVE identifier that this record pertains to.

requester_user_id.description: The user that requested the CVE identifier.

serial.description: Monotonically increasing integer, starting at 1, incremented each time a submission from a data provider changes this CVE Record.

CveMetadataPublished.title: CveMetadataPublished

CveMetadataRejected.description: Metadata for a CVE Record in the REJECTED state.

assigner_org_id.description: The UUID for the organization to which the CVE ID was originally assigned. This UUID can be used to lookup the organization record in the user registry service.

assigner_short_name.description: The short name for the organization to which the CVE ID was originally assigned.

date_published.description: The date/time the CVE Record was first published in the CVE List.

date_rejected.description: The date/time the CVE ID was rejected.

date_reserved.description: The date/time this CVE ID was reserved in the CVE automation workgroup services system. This date does not necessarily indicate when the vulnerability was discovered, shared with the vendor, or publicly disclosed.

date_updated.description: The date/time the record was last updated.

record_cve_id.description: The CVE identifier that this record pertains to.

rejected_state.description: State of the CVE Record. For rejected records, this is always REJECTED.

serial.description: Monotonically increasing integer, starting at 1, incremented each time a submission from a data provider changes this CVE Record.

CveMetadataRejected.title: CveMetadataRejected

CveReference.description: An external reference associated with a CVE Record. Extends the core Reference with optional descriptive tags characterizing the resource.

name.description: Name of the entity (product, weakness, reference, etc.).

reference_tags.description: An array of tags describing the resource referenced by the URL.

source.description: Source or origin of the reference or data.

url.description: URL pointing to the reference resource.

CveReference.title: CveReference

Cvss2CollateralDamagePotential.description: CVSS 2.0 collateral damage potential environmental metric.
Cvss2CollateralDamagePotential.title: Cvss2CollateralDamagePotential

Cvss3ExploitCodeMaturity.description: CVSS 3.x exploit code maturity temporal metric.
Cvss3ExploitCodeMaturity.title: Cvss3ExploitCodeMaturity

Cvss3ModifiedAttackComplexity.description: CVSS 3.x modified attack complexity environmental metric.
Cvss3ModifiedAttackComplexity.title: Cvss3ModifiedAttackComplexity

Cvss3ModifiedAttackVector.description: CVSS 3.x modified attack vector environmental metric.
Cvss3ModifiedAttackVector.title: Cvss3ModifiedAttackVector

Cvss3ModifiedPrivilegesRequired.description: CVSS 3.x modified privileges required environmental metric.
Cvss3ModifiedPrivilegesRequired.title: Cvss3ModifiedPrivilegesRequired

Cvss3ModifiedUserInteraction.description: CVSS 3.x modified user interaction environmental metric.
Cvss3ModifiedUserInteraction.title: Cvss3ModifiedUserInteraction

Cvss4ModifiedAttackComplexity.description: CVSS 4.0 modified attack complexity environmental metric.
Cvss4ModifiedAttackComplexity.title: Cvss4ModifiedAttackComplexity

Cvss4ModifiedAttackRequirements.description: CVSS 4.0 modified attack requirements environmental metric.
Cvss4ModifiedAttackRequirements.title: Cvss4ModifiedAttackRequirements

Cvss4ModifiedAttackVector.description: CVSS 4.0 modified attack vector environmental metric.
Cvss4ModifiedAttackVector.title: Cvss4ModifiedAttackVector

Cvss4ModifiedPrivilegesRequired.description: CVSS 4.0 modified privileges required environmental metric.
Cvss4ModifiedPrivilegesRequired.title: Cvss4ModifiedPrivilegesRequired

Cvss4ModifiedSubC.description: CVSS 4.0 modified subsequent system confidentiality environmental metric.
Cvss4ModifiedSubC.title: Cvss4ModifiedSubC

Cvss4ModifiedSubIa.description: CVSS 4.0 modified subsequent system integrity/availability environmental metric (includes SAFETY value).
Cvss4ModifiedSubIa.title: Cvss4ModifiedSubIa

Cvss4ModifiedUserInteraction.description: CVSS 4.0 modified user interaction environmental metric.
Cvss4ModifiedUserInteraction.title: Cvss4ModifiedUserInteraction

Cvss4ModifiedVulnCia.description: CVSS 4.0 modified vulnerable system CIA environmental metric.
Cvss4ModifiedVulnCia.title: Cvss4ModifiedVulnCia

Cvss4SubCia.description: CVSS 4.0 subsequent system confidentiality/integrity/availability impact base metric.
Cvss4SubCia.title: Cvss4SubCia

Cvss4VulnCia.description: CVSS 4.0 vulnerable system confidentiality/integrity/availability impact base metric.
Cvss4VulnCia.title: Cvss4VulnCia

Cvss4VulnerabilityResponseEffort.description: CVSS 4.0 vulnerability response effort supplemental metric.
Cvss4VulnerabilityResponseEffort.title: Cvss4VulnerabilityResponseEffort

CvssV20.description: CVSS version 2.0 scoring object. Requires version ('2.0'), vectorString, and baseScore.

cvss2_vector_string.description: CVSS 2.0 vector string encoding all base, temporal, and environmental metrics.

cvss2_version.description: CVSS version identifier. Must be '2.0' for CVSS v2.0 objects.

CvssV20.title: CvssV20

CvssV3.description: CVSS version 3.x scoring object covering both CVSS 3.0 and CVSS 3.1. The two versions share an identical metric model; the 3.1 spec was a clarification, not a structural change. The cvss3_version slot distinguishes between them. Requires version ('3.0' or '3.1'), vectorString, baseScore, and baseSeverity.

cvss3_vector_string.description: CVSS 3.x vector string encoding all metric values. CVSS 3.1 strings begin with 'CVSS:3.1/'; CVSS 3.0 strings begin with 'CVSS:3.0/'.

cvss3_version.description: CVSS version identifier ('3.0' or '3.1') within a CvssV3 object.

CvssV3.title: CvssV3

CvssV3Version.description: CVSS version 3.x identifier. CVSS 3.0 and 3.1 share an identical metric model; the 3.1 spec was a clarification, not a structural change. The consolidated CvssV3 class accepts either via this enum.
CvssV3Version.title: CvssV3Version

CvssV40.description: CVSS version 4.0 scoring object. Requires version, vectorString, baseScore, and baseSeverity. All other fields are optional.

cvss4_vector_string.description: CVSS 4.0 vector string encoding all base, threat, and environmental metrics.

cvss4_version.description: CVSS version identifier. Must be '4.0' for CVSS v4.0 objects.

CvssV40.title: CvssV40

DataType.description: Indicates the type of information represented in a CVE JSON instance.
DataType.title: DataType

Impact.description: Assessment of the vulnerability's impact and severity.

score.description: Numeric vulnerability score (e.g. CVSS base score).

vector.description: CVSS vector string or equivalent scoring vector expression.

Impact.title: Impact

ImpactEntry.description: An impact entry linking an optional CAPEC attack pattern ID to one or more prose descriptions of the impact scenario.

capec_id.description: CAPEC ID that best relates to this impact (e.g., CAPEC-123).

impact_descriptions.description: Prose description of the impact scenario. At a minimum, provide the description given by CAPEC.

ImpactEntry.title: ImpactEntry

MetricEntry.description: A metric entry containing scoring data in one of the CVSS formats (v4.0, v3.x, v2.0) or a custom format, with optional applicability scenarios. At least one of cvss_v4_0, cvss_v3, cvss_v2_0, or other_metric is required. CVSS 3.0 and 3.1 are both represented by CvssV3 (distinguished by the cvss3_version slot).

cvss_v3.description: CVSS version 3.x scoring data (covers both 3.0 and 3.1). The version is distinguished by the cvss3_version field within the CvssV3 object.

metric_format.description: Name of the scoring format (e.g., cvssV4_0, cvssV3_1). Provides future-proofing and supports proprietary format inclusion.

metric_scenarios.description: Scenarios this metrics object applies to. If no specific scenario is given, GENERAL applies when no more specific metric matches.

other_metric.description: A non-standard impact description or score.

MetricEntry.title: MetricEntry

MetricScenario.description: A scenario description indicating the context in which a metric applies. If no specific scenario is given, GENERAL is used as the default.

lang.description: BCP 47 language code indicating the language of accompanying text.

scenario_value.description: Description of the scenario this metrics object applies to.

MetricScenario.title: MetricScenario

MultiLangDescription.description: Text in a particular language with optional alternate markup or formatted representation (e.g., Markdown) or embedded media. Used for vulnerability descriptions, rejected reasons, configurations, workarounds, solutions, and exploits.

lang.description: BCP 47 language code indicating the language of accompanying text.

supporting_media.description: Supporting media data for the description such as markdown, diagrams, etc. Similar to RFC 2397, each object has a media type, data value, and optional base64 flag.

MultiLangDescription.title: MultiLangDescription

OtherMetric.description: A non-standard impact description in a custom format. May be a prose description or an arbitrary JSON-compatible object.

other_metric_content.description: Arbitrary JSON-compatible object (or prose string) containing non-standard metric data not covered by the CVSS formats. Upstream JSON Schema defines this as 'type: object, minProperties: 1'; range: Any allows any value.

other_metric_type.description: Name of the non-standard impact metrics format used.

OtherMetric.title: OtherMetric

ProblemType.description: Problem type information (e.g., CWE identifier). Wraps one or more problem type descriptions. The CNA requirement is [PROBLEMTYPE].

problem_type_descriptions.description: One or more problem type descriptions (e.g., CWE IDs or OWASP categories).

ProblemType.title: ProblemType

cwe_id.description: CWE identifier for the weakness classification (e.g. CWE-79).

lang.description: BCP 47 language code indicating the language of accompanying text.

problem_description.description: Text description of the problem type, or title from CWE or OWASP.

problem_references.description: References supporting this specific problem type.

problem_source_type.description: Problem type source format (e.g., text, OWASP, CWE).

Product.description: Software or hardware entity affected by the vulnerability.

name.description: Name of the entity (product, weakness, reference, etc.).

vendor.description: Name of the vendor or organization responsible for the product.

version.description: Version string of the affected product.

Product.title: Product

ProgramRoutine.description: An affected source code function, method, subroutine, or procedure.

routine_name.description: Name of the affected source code function, method, subroutine, or procedure.

ProgramRoutine.title: ProgramRoutine

ProviderMetadata.description: Details related to the information container provider (CNA or ADP).

date_updated.description: The date/time the record was last updated.

short_name.description: The container provider's organizational short name (2-32 characters).

ProviderMetadata.title: ProviderMetadata

RecordState.description: Lifecycle state of a CVE Record (PUBLISHED or REJECTED).
RecordState.title: RecordState

Reference.description: External reference such as an advisory or article.

name.description: Name of the entity (product, weakness, reference, etc.).

source.description: Source or origin of the reference or data.

url.description: URL pointing to the reference resource.

Reference.title: Reference

ReferenceTag.description: A tag describing the type or nature of the resource referenced by a URL.
ReferenceTag.title: ReferenceTag

SourceInformation.description: Source information (who discovered it, who researched it, etc.) and optionally a chain of CNA information. This is an open object — at least one property must be present.

source_advisory.description: Advisory identifier associated with the vulnerability discovery.

source_defects.description: Bug tracking system IDs (e.g., JIRA ticket IDs) related to the vulnerability.

source_discovery.description: How the vulnerability was discovered (e.g., INTERNAL, EXTERNAL, USER).

SourceInformation.title: SourceInformation

SupportingMedia.description: Supporting media data for a description such as markdown, diagrams, etc. Similar to RFC 2397, each media object has a media type, data value, and an optional base64 flag.

base64_encoded.description: If true, the media_value field contains the media data encoded in base64. If false, the media_value field contains UTF-8 media content.

media_type.description: RFC2046 compliant IANA Media type (e.g., text/markdown, text/html, image/png, image/svg, audio/mp3).

media_value.description: Supporting media content, up to 16K characters. If base64_encoded is true, this stores base64 encoded data.

SupportingMedia.title: SupportingMedia

TaxonomyMapping.description: A taxonomy mapping identifying the taxonomy by name and version, along with a list of relations relevant to the CVE (e.g., ATT&CK, D3FEND, CWE).

taxonomy_name.description: The name of the taxonomy (e.g., ATT&CK, D3FEND, CWE, CVSS).

taxonomy_relations.description: List of relationships to the taxonomy for this vulnerability.

taxonomy_version.description: The version of the taxonomy the identifiers come from.

TaxonomyMapping.title: TaxonomyMapping

TaxonomyRelation.description: A relationship between a taxonomy item and a CVE or another taxonomy item. Provides subject (taxonomyId), predicate (relationshipName), and object (relationshipValue).

relationship_name.description: A description of the relationship between the taxonomy item and the CVE.

relationship_value.description: The target of the relationship. Can be the CVE ID or another taxonomy identifier.

taxonomy_id.description: Identifier of the item in the taxonomy. Used as the subject of the relationship.

TaxonomyRelation.title: TaxonomyRelation

TimelineEntry.description: A timeline event recording a significant event about the vulnerability or changes to the CVE Record. Requires time, lang, and value.

event_time.description: Timestamp representing when the event in the timeline occurred. Format is RFC3339 / ISO8601 with optional timezone.

event_value.description: A summary of the timeline event (up to 4096 characters).

lang.description: BCP 47 language code indicating the language of accompanying text.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry

VersionChange.description: A status change that takes place at a specific point within a version range.

change_at.description: The version at which a status change occurs within a range.

change_status.description: The new status in the range starting at the given version.

VersionChange.title: VersionChange

VersionEntry.description: A single version or a range of versions of a product with associated vulnerability status. An entry with only version and status is a point version; an entry with versionType and a less-than limit describes a range.

less_than.description: The non-inclusive upper limit of the range. This is the least version NOT in the range. Supports wildcard '*' suffix.

less_than_or_equal.description: The inclusive upper limit of the range. This is the greatest version contained in the range. Only one of lessThan and lessThanOrEqual should be specified.

version_changes.description: A list of status changes that take place during the version range. The array should be sorted by 'at' field according to versionType, but clients must re-sort rather than assume ordering.

version_status.description: The vulnerability status for the version or range of versions. For a range, the status may be refined by the 'changes' list.

version_type.description: The version numbering system used for specifying the range (e.g., semver, git, maven, rpm, python, custom). Defines the semantics of comparison.

version_value.description: The single version being described, or the version at the start of the range. By convention, '0' denotes the earliest possible version.

VersionEntry.title: VersionEntry

VersionStatus.description: The vulnerability status of a given version or range of versions of a product.
VersionStatus.title: VersionStatus

VulnerabilityStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a vulnerability record.
VulnerabilityStatus.title: VulnerabilityStatus

Weakness.description: Weakness classification from CWE or a similar taxonomy.

cwe_id.description: CWE identifier for the weakness classification (e.g. CWE-79).

name.description: Name of the entity (product, weakness, reference, etc.).

Weakness.title: Weakness
